title: Invertibility of the open-immersion coefficient unit
statement: Let $j:Y\to X$ be an open immersion of schemes and $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module. Let $U_X$ and $U_Y$ forget modules to abelian sheaves. The abelian adjunct of the module pullback unit $M\to j_*j^*M$ [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison], namely $j^{-1}U_X(M)\to U_Y(j^*M)$, is an isomorphism. This holds for every module, without flatness or quasi-coherence.

source.place: Lemma 18.20.1, lemma-localize-morphism-ringed-sites, final parenthetical: inverse image and module pullback agree for localization morphisms; open-subscheme specialization.

proof.text: Use Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.sheafPullbackIso to identify abelian inverse image with restriction on opens. Use Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback to identify module restriction with module pullback. The underlying abelian sheaf of the explicit module restriction is the explicit abelian restriction, since j.appIso is invertible.

The module unit is the restriction unit followed by restrictFunctorIsoPullback (pullbackUnit_eq_of_isOpenImmersion in the source library). Take abelian adjuncts. The restriction unit is adjunct to the identity of restriction; hence the coefficient map is exactly the composite of the two isomorphisms from the first step. Therefore it is invertible, also on empty schemes and for zero modules.
